ns0:TileMatrixSet.ns2:Title: TileMatrix using 0.28mm
ns0:TileMatrixSet.ns2:Abstract: The tile matrix set that has scale values calculated based on the dpi defined by OGC specification (dpi assumes 0.28mm as the physical distance of a pixel).

ns0:TileMatrixSet.ns2:Title: GoogleMapsCompatible
ns0:TileMatrixSet.ns2:Abstract: the wellknown 'GoogleMapsCompatible' tile matrix set defined by OGC WMTS specification
